label: clause-initial function words
explanation: Fires on function words that open clauses/phrases (which, who, that, and, or, to, of, with) after commas or sequence starts; strongest at sequence start; not on 'the' or content words.
examples_shown: [START]<<which>> was the literal truth  and he had
[START]<<with>><< her>><< great>> rack<< and>> eagerness<< to>><< get>>
[START] contractors<< who>><< have>> proven themselves<< to>> be honest<< and>> reliable
[START] adoption<< upon>> the child<<’>>s birth.< If> they
[START]<< those>><< who>><<,>><< at>><< age>> 55<<,>><< do>><< not>><< have>> hypertension
